name: 3-2-1 Blast Off Simulator
desc:
An Adventure Simulator where you collect fuel to blast off on your rocket and do island challenges in three different dimensions!

The more fuel you add to the rocket, the higher you go and the more cash you earn.

Fly high and become a Blast Off Legend!

Have Fun!

Latest Version - 7.3

Added Classic Easter Fuel Bot!
